title: ntn.gps Response Application Programming Interface (API) Schema
description: Response indicating current Starnote GPS/GNSS location configuration.

off.description: Returned and `true` if the Notecard does not supply its location to a paired Starnote. Starnote relies solely on its own GPS/GNSS module.

on.description: Returned and `true` if the Notecard supplies a location it already knows to a paired Starnote.

samples.title: Notecard Location Not Supplied
samples.description: Response indicating the Notecard does not supply its location, so Starnote relies solely on its own GPS/GNSS module (default).

samples.title: Notecard Location Supplied
samples.description: Response indicating the Notecard supplies a location it already knows to the paired Starnote.
